c1.hasil_ringkas: YOLOv8s yang dioptimalkan (mAP@0,5 92,5%) dengan ByteTrack dan ROI penghitung pada 20 video rumah kaca menghasilkan R2 0,914, MAE 8,55 buah, dan MAPE 9,52% terhadap hitungan manual; per kelas R2 0,950 (matang), 0,752 (setengah matang), dan 0,910 (mentah).

bukti: This system processes video streams and uses the ByteTrack MOT algorithm to accurately identify, track, and count individual strawberries according to the ripeness class across frames.
By including the class variable, the matching process between predicted and detected objects is performed on a per-class basis
the ground truth was established by two independent operators manually counting all strawberry fruits of each ripeness level in every row after data collection
catatan: Kelas dimasukkan ke vektor keadaan Kalman ByteTrack dan pencocokan dilakukan per kelas; duplikat dicegah dengan pemeriksaan track-ID saat sentroid memasuki ROI. Metrik identitas (MOTA, IDF1) tidak dilaporkan.

bukti: a system is proposed to identify ready-to-harvest FFB automatically by counting loose fruitlets on the ground
The tree is tracked when the lower midpoint of the detected tree enters the monitoring region to ensure that each tree is classified only once.
After tracking for a predetermined number of frames (n), a final count was made based on the highest counting frequency.
catatan: Kode utama C3 karena kontribusi utamanya deteksi brondolan dan prediksi siap panen. C1 juga cocok: video berjalan, pohon dilacak berdasarkan konsistensi deteksi antarframe (M3) agar tiap pohon dihitung sekali, dan jumlah brondolan diambil sebagai modus hitungan per frame selama n frame (agregasi statistik tanpa identitas brondolan, dikodekan M1 sebagai pendekatan terdekat). Tidak ada galat hitung brondolan; yang dievaluasi adalah akurasi keputusan siap panen berdasarkan ambang hitung. per_kelas C3 = Y merujuk pada status siap panen per pohon, bukan kelas kematangan per tandan. The model was constructed incorporating a transfer learning approach with an Xception model. The model achieved an overall accuracy of 80.4%.

bukti: This UAV system produces high-resolution digital image that can be used to calculate the number of plants. The number of plants in this particular area is then used as input to predict the crop.
Production Estimation 100% = Number of trees x (mean ± standard deviation)

c1.hasil_ringkas: Pada dataset MOT tandan tomat (lebih dari 165.172 instans), YOLOv8 dan RT-DETR mencapai mAP@75 93,6% dan 94,9%; RT-DETR dengan ByteTrack memberi akurasi hitung tertinggi 95,5%, sedangkan BoT-SORT memberi MOTA tertinggi 84,6%.

bukti: we herein establish a public multi-object tracking (MOT) dataset for tomato cluster counts, while evaluating and comparing state-of-the-art target detection and MOT-based algorithms
The tracking algorithms included state-of-the-art methodologies such as SORT, DeepSort, ByteTrack, and BotSort.
the ByteTrack-based algorithm registers the highest counting accuracy at 95.5%, whereas BotSort achieves the highest MOTA score with 84.6%
catatan: Studi pembanding empat pelacak: SORT dan ByteTrack (M3), DeepSORT dan BoT-SORT dengan modul ReID (M2+M3). Hitungan terbaik berasal dari ByteTrack tanpa ReID sehingga penghapus duplikat dikodekan M3. Abstrak tidak merinci aturan penghitungan (garis atau ID unik) dan acuan hitung diasumsikan anotasi dataset MOT.

bukti: we apply multi-source feature fusion by combining vegetation indices from UAV remote sensing imagery, structural feature ratios from ground-based fruit tree images, and leaf chlorophyll content (SPAD)
The SVM model based on multi-source feature fusion achieved the highest apple yield estimation accuracy in small-scale orchard sample plots (R2 = 0.942, RMSE = 12.980 kg).
